title: SF4688 (2025-2026 Regular): Regulation changes of transfers of pistols and semiautomatic military-style assault weapons to include ammunition

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2026-03-18; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2026/0/SF/4688/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (Introduction, 2026-03-18). Large bill (23 sections); the main change is replacing 'pistol or semiautomatic military-style assault weapon' with a defined 'firearm-related item' that adds ammunition for those guns, across Minn. Stat. 624.7131, 624.7132 and 624.7134. Sections effective August 1, 2026. Quotes are a selection; not all sections are quoted.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7131, subd. 1): (4) a statement by the proposed transferee that the proposed transferee is not prohibited by section 624.713 from possessing a firearm-related item.
Section 9 (Minn. Stat. 624.7132, subd. 4): No person shall deliver a firearm-related item to a proposed transferee after receiving a written notification that the chief of police or sheriff has determined that the proposed transferee is prohibited by section 624.713 from possessing the firearm-related item.
Section 15 (Minn. Stat. 624.7132, subd. 15): (a) Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (b), a person who does any of the following is guilty of a gross misdemeanor: (1) transfers a firearm-related item in violation of subdivisions 1 to 13;
Section 15 (Minn. Stat. 624.7132, subd. 15): (b) A person who does either of the following is guilty of a felony: (1) transfers a firearm-related item to a person under the age of 18 in violation of subdivisions 1 to 13; or
Section 16 (Minn. Stat. 624.7132, subd. 16): This section shall be construed to supersede municipal or county regulation of the transfer of firearm-related items.
Section 18 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 1): (c) "Firearm-related item" includes a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon, a pistol, and ammunition for a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon or pistol.
Section 19 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 2): An unlicensed person is prohibited from transferring a firearm-related item to any other unlicensed person, unless: (1) the transfer is made through a firearms dealer as provided for in subdivision 3; or (2) the transferee presents a valid transferee permit issued under section 624.7131 and a current state or federally issued identification.
Section 21 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 4): (d) If the transfer involves ammunition, the record of transfer must also contain the following information about the ammunition: (1) its caliber or gauge; (2) its specific product line and manufacturer; (3) its weight or grain; and (4) its type.
